target: Optimal Blue (business of Black Knight, Inc.)

deal_value.notes: US$700M: US$200M cash plus a US$500M promissory note issued by Constellation to Black Knight (as ICE subsidiary) at closing. Divestiture required to clear ICE's acquisition of Black Knight. Announced July 17, 2023; closed September 15, 2023.

calculable.calculation: US$700M / ~US$110M annual revenue (figure publicly reported at Black Knight's 2020 acquisition of Optimal Blue) = ~6.4x
inputs: US$700M deal value ($200M cash + $500M promissory note) — https://ir.theice.com/press/news-details/2023/Intercontinental-Exchange-and-Black-Knight-Announce-Agreement-to-Sell-Black-Knights-Optimal-Blue-Business-to-Constellation-Software-Inc/default.aspx and https://www.csisoftware.com/category/press-releases/2023/07/17/constellation-software-s-perseus-group-enters-into-agreement-to-acquire-black-knight-s-optimal-blue-business

Optimal Blue ~US$110M annual revenue, reported when Black Knight agreed to buy it for $1.8B in 2020 — https://www.housingwire.com/articles/black-knight-to-acquire-optimal-blue-in-1-8b-deal-to-boost-origination-offerings/
calculable.caveats: The only public standalone revenue figure (~$110M) dates to the 2020 Black Knight acquisition; no 2022/2023 standalone Optimal Blue revenue was disclosed by Black Knight, ICE, or Constellation, so any implied multiple uses a stale denominator. Note-heavy consideration ($500M vendor note) also blurs effective value.

notes: Hint date resolved: announced July 17, 2023 and closed September 15, 2023 — not 2024. Deal value and structure ($700M = $200M cash + $500M promissory note) are firmly published; no valuation multiple was published, and the only public revenue benchmark is the ~$110M figure from the 2020 sale to Black Knight (which was widely noted as making the $700M exit roughly 40% of Black Knight's $1.8B purchase price). ICE IR page returned 403 to direct fetch; terms confirmed across CSI press release, HousingWire, Globe and Mail, and Business Wire copies.
